plain: A researcher named Ning Li is said to have found an unusual effect from spinning superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance, in work tied to the hunt for antigravity. Charles Buhler, whom the episode presents as a NASA figure, tells Michels that NASA, as he thinks, tried to reproduce it and did not see the effect.
